headline: Ledger Shows Fresh Shifts on Several Fronts
war_summary: Base ledgers remain unsettled, but the latest returns show no victor and the 34-town standard is still unmet. Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse’s 24-hour base-event count has eased from 61 to 46; Kuura Strand’s from 35 to 31, and Marban Hollow’s from 34 to 26. Nevish Line moved the other way, from 20 to 23. Activity persists: Weathered recorded two events in the latest two hours, Kuura three, Nevish one, and Stlican Shelf two. Marban logged 13 in six hours, though none in the latest two. Weathered remains divided two Warden, four Colonial and three neutral; Kuura’s six bases are Colonial-held, and Nevish Line remains five Warden to three Colonial. Stlican Shelf stands seven Colonial, one Warden and one neutral. Stonecradle’s six daily events have gone quiet in the latest two hours, while Linn Mercy recorded ten in the past day, with its latest shift well back. Casualties and enlistments indicate regional activity, not present troop strength.
